_notes: Vocab = picture-vocabulary (4-AFC). The model is given the spoken word (the narration transcript) and must pick the matching picture by grid position. Ability spread from model tier + child-age IRT persona + temperature seeds; stimulus never altered. Run per language with --lang en-US|de-DE|nl. For nl the narration mp3s don't exist yet, so set QA_AUDIO_PLACEHOLDER=en-US (silent placeholder audio) + QA_TRANSLATIONS_SOURCE=crowdin-approved: the word then comes from the Crowdin-approved Dutch text the real mp3 will be generated from.
